operators.name: bilinear_upsample

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: supports strides; kernel may require contiguous, binding will ensure contiguity

semantics: Corresponds to nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2.0, mode='bilinear') with input [16,32,512,256] and output [16,32,1024,512]
Uses bilinear interpolation with align_corners=False (default); scale_factor is applied to height and width
Output tensor is contiguous with shape [N, C, H*scale_factor, W*scale_factor]

operators.name: squeeze_identity

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: supports strides; does not modify storage, returns same tensor if no dims are 1; otherwise returns a view with squeezed dims

returns.shape: same as input if no dimension is 1; otherwise squeezed shape

semantics: Matches torch.squeeze(x) for 4D tensor without specifying dim
If no dimension is 1, returns the same tensor (or a view with same shape and stride)
Bilinear upsample with scale_factor=2.0, mode='bilinear', align_corners=False
torch.squeeze on [16,32,1024,512] does nothing because no dimension is 1; output identical to input
Returns tensor with same shape, dtype, device, stride
Final output is the squeezed tensor, same as step_002
